description: This file defines types and interfaces related to agent commands, including options for messaging, imagery, stream parameters, context, and routing within a conversational agent system.

classes.name: ImageContent
classes.description: Represents an image message content, including type, data, and MIME type.

classes.name: AgentStreamParams
classes.description: Parameters for streaming agent responses, such as temperature, max tokens, and fast mode.

classes.name: AgentRunContext
classes.description: Contextual information for an agent run, including messaging channels, identifiers, and reply modes.

classes.name: AgentCommandOpts
classes.description: Options for executing an agent command, including message content, images, tools, routing, session, and other control parameters.

classes.name: AgentCommandIngressOpts
classes.description: Ingest options for agent commands, extending AgentCommandOpts with explicit authorization flags.
